hackathons.title: AI Lodge Hackathon 2026
hackathons.summary: The AI Lodge Hackathon 2026 is an online coding challenge hosted by Singapore Management University. Participants develop novel artificial intelligence solutions to compete for $2,500 in prizes.

hackathons.title: Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.organizer: KamandPrompt – Programming Club of IIT Mandi
hackathons.summary: Organized by IIT Mandi's programming club, this online competition centers on multimodal AI development. Participants create AI models that process diverse data modalities.

hackathons.title: Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026 by IIT Mandi
hackathons.organizer: KamandPrompt – Programming Club of IIT Mandi
hackathons.summary: Organized by the KamandPrompt programming club of IIT Mandi, this online hackathon focuses on multimodal AI applications. Students can participate to showcase their artificial intelligence solutions and earn rewards.

hackathons.title: cruXipher 2026 - ATMoS '26
hackathons.eligibility: Open to university students and Computer Science undergraduates
hackathons.summary: cruXipher 2026 is a CTF cybersecurity competition organized during the ATMoS '26 festival at BITS Hyderabad. Participants solve security challenges to demonstrate their problem-solving and technical capabilities.

hackathons.title: HITCON CTF 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: HITCON CTF 2026 is a Jeopardy-style online cybersecurity competition hosting global participants. Contestants solve challenges across reverse engineering, web exploitation, and cryptography.

hackathons.title: Build With AI: Basics 2026
hackathons.summary: Build With AI: Basics 2026 is an online hackathon hosted by Devpost. It invites participants to build entry-level artificial intelligence projects to compete for an $850 prize pool.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students and young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon challenges engineering students and young engineers to collaborate on solutions for sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams to solve global engineering challenges.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students or young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites engineering students and young engineers to solve real-world challenges in sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams to build and submit innovative solutions for global impact.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days
hackathons.eligibility: Students and early-career developers across India
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is a free online AI engineering hackathon for students and early-career developers across India. Participants collaborate virtually to build and ship innovative artificial intelligence projects.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days 2026
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is an online AI engineering hackathon open to participants across India. Participants focus on building AI agents, automations, and LLM applications.
